updates.failure.checkUntyped: Cmdr couldn’t check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again later.
updates.failure.download: Cmdr couldn’t download the update. Try again later.
updates.failure.install: Cmdr couldn’t install the update. Try again later, or get the latest Cmdr from getcmdr.com.
updates.failure.notGenuine: Cmdr didn’t install this update: it isn’t a genuine Cmdr release.
updates.toast.ready: A new version of Cmdr is ready.
updates.toast.readyDetail: Restart now, or you’ll get it the next time you open Cmdr.
updates.toast.securityFix: This update fixes {count, plural, one {a security issue} other {# security issues}}.
updates.toast.securityFixDetail: Restart Cmdr to finish installing it.
updates.unwritable.adminHeadline: Cmdr {version} is out, but Cmdr can’t install it itself
updates.unwritable.adminDetail: {path} belongs to another account. To update, download Cmdr from <website>getcmdr.com</website> and drag it into Applications. macOS will ask for your password.
updates.unwritable.standardDetail: Your account can’t update Cmdr on this Mac. Ask your IT team, or whoever manages this Mac, to update it.
updates.moveToApplicationsDialog.title: Move Cmdr to your Applications folder
updates.moveToApplicationsDialog.translo: A new version is ready, but macOS is running Cmdr from a temporary read-only copy of itself. That’s what happens when you open an app straight from where you downloaded it, and it means updates have nowhere to land.
updates.moveToApplicationsDialog.readOnl: A new version is ready, but Cmdr is running from a read-only spot, usually a disk image that’s still mounted. That means updates have nowhere to land.
updates.moveToApplicationsDialog.howTo: Quit Cmdr, drag it into your Applications folder, and open it from there. Every update after that arrives on its own.
updates.status.noUpdates: No updates found. Current version: v{version}
updates.status.managedOff: Your organization manages updates for Cmdr.
updates.status.heldByPolicy: Cmdr {available} is out, but your organization keeps this Mac on {ceiling} or earlier.
updates.status.unwritableAdmin: Cmdr {version} is out, but Cmdr can’t install it itself. Download it from getcmdr.com and drag it into Applications.
updates.status.unwritableStandard: Cmdr {version} is out, but your account can’t update Cmdr on this Mac.
updates.status.ready: Update v{next} ready. Restart to apply.
